name: Whispering Spirits
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #1-01: The Absalom Initiation

stealth.note: (trained) to hear the whispers from a distance

description: Lost spirits whisper, reliving their last moments, ready to drag the living into their illusion.
disable: DC 16 Religion check (trained) to suppress the spirits or DC 16 Performance check (trained) to drown them out
reset: The underlying spirits remain, resetting the haunt every midnight, until what truly happened here becomes public.

offensiveAbilities.name: Luring Whispers
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Multiple creatures remain in area C4 for more than 6 seconds.

Effect The whispers become more insistent until each character in the room must attempt a DC 18 Will save.

On a failure, a creature is Confused for 1 round (or for 1d6+1 rounds on a critical failure). Both the audible whispers and the babbling of the confused are related to the haunting's origin.

Owners Whispers and Babbles
Archdevil worshippers Desperate praise of Mephistopheles
Soulbound dollmakers Pleading "don't make me go in the doll again"
Alchemical experimenters Frantic claims of not wanting to live forever anymore
Slavers Begging to be allowed to be released in multiple languages
Crime lords Promising not to mess with the family again
Misguided Pharasmins Sighing desires to be put to rest
